prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: ONE polished DESKTOP COMPUTER in-game HUD concept image for a Chinese fairy-tale side-scrolling witch shooter.
Input image: the attached landscape mobile screenshot is an EDIT TARGET and visual style master. Preserve the approved A direction: moonlit translucent glass, thin cream outlines, gentle amber fire ring and pale lavender-blue bloom ring, existing watercolor heroine and moonlit lakeside village art.
Primary request: recompose this image into a proper 16:9 desktop keyboard-and-mouse gameplay interface, ideally 1920x1080 landscape. One full screenshot, edge-to-edge game, no monitor frame, no surrounding page, no perspective. Strongly preserve its watercolor scene, detailed lakeside village, moon, muted violet mountains, little cream-hatted blonde twin-braided witch flying right on broom, gray round woolly night-monster boss and restrained pink enemy bullets.

Critical desktop changes:
1. Remove the entire lower-left virtual joystick. Remove both large right-side mobile buttons and all mobile-control outlines. Restore the scenery in those regions. There are NO thumb controls or right-side buttons.
2. Put EXACTLY TWO compact circular ability medallions SIDE BY SIDE at bottom LEFT, near x6% and x12%, y91%. Each about 7% image height, much smaller than the original mobile controls. Transparent smoky-indigo interiors, fine rings and tiny subtle stars, clean chunky icons. Left medallion warm amber flame; Chinese label "炉火", stock "2/3" inside. Right medallion pale lavender four-petal star-flower; label "绽放", status "就绪" inside. Both aligned, same diameter, modest glow and NO big enclosing panel. Attach a tiny keyboard keycap "Z" to lower rim of fire, tiny keycap "E" to lower rim of bloom. The keycaps are hints attached to existing medallions, NOT additional buttons. Stock and status must each be readable. Touch UI is completely gone.
3. Top-left hearts: four filled soft pink hearts and one dim heart, at modest desktop size. Below hearts a compact label "射击 L3" and slim pale-gold shooting-growth progress bar. No broad opaque header.
4. Top-center form a compact coherent information cluster. First small line "湖畔夜巡 · 02:00". Below it one clear Boss title "湖边大夜怪". Below that ONE thin coral health bar about 30% screen width, 65% filled, TWO distinct stage tick marks at one-third and two-thirds; short current-phase label "聚雾" below. Keep entire cluster within the upper 12% of frame. No duplicate Boss health bar elsewhere.
5. Top-right show score "11920 分", cream numerals, and beside it a small thin outlined pause circle with two vertical bars. Balanced with left status cluster, all comfortably inset from window edges.
6. Bottom RIGHT a small low-priority cream-gray keyboard help line verbatim "WASD 移动 · 空格 射击 · P 暂停". Discreet but readable, on empty scenery. No large opaque footer. Leave central and right bottom areas largely open.
7. Heroine about x29%,y52%, boss x76%,y51%, full clear silhouettes within the central playfield. A few star shots traveling right, several enemy pink bullets toward left in the central combat zone only. Main action unobstructed; controls never cover heroine or dangerous attacks. Full-screen continuous scenic background, subtle low edge shading only.

Exact allowed UI text only: "射击 L3", "湖畔夜巡 · 02:00", "湖边大夜怪", "聚雾", "11920 分", "炉火", "2/3", "Z", "绽放", "就绪", "E", "WASD 移动 · 空格 射击 · P 暂停". High-quality readable Chinese type, cream and lavender text with restrained shadows. All figures and labels integrated into functional HUD.
Constraints: only the two established abilities, no MP bar, no skill selection, no additional magic, no joystick, no touch-control guides, no arrow keys drawn as controls, no mobile phone mockup, no skill strip across the screen, no big cards, no extra portraits, no currency/shop/menu, no parchment panels, no ornate heavy frames, no brand logos. Keep night color scheme and transparent floating A-style circular controls. This should read immediately as an elegant desktop game screenshot with full playfield and compact mouse/keyboard HUD.
